- Windows 10/11 x64 support, with native context menus, configurable quick input, and in-app updates.
- Refined settings layout and platform-specific keyboard shortcut hints.
- Syntax highlighting in the trajectory JSON view.

**macOS 13+** (Apple silicon and Intel):

```sh
curl -fsSL https://im.linghaoz.com/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows 10/11 (x64):** download and run `im_x64-setup.exe` from the assets below. It installs for your account without administrator rights.

Installed copies check for updates in the app. You can also check manually in **Settings → General → Version**.
